findings.progressionAndNoncredit: OER 9.1: Year-3 research seminars require all first-year courses; thesis and colloquium require all Years 1 and 2. OER 10.4: zero-EC Dutch diagnostic and any required refresher gate the Academic Skills grade. BSA 42 first-year EC plus Academic Skills and language test. findings.openStudy: OER 12.1–12.2: 30 EC open study; individual package includes at least 12 EC level 300 and prior board consent. Eligible University/listed faculty minors have consent exceptions, subject to entry rules; compulsory overlap needs approved replacement. Abroad 30 or internship 12 plus electives 18 occupy the same allowance.
findings.thesisAndMethods: Annual thesis: supervised individual historical question, status quaestionis and bounded literature, optionally primary sources. Colloquium: signed topic/supervisor agreement by period 4, timetable, status quaestionis, introduction/work plan and poster; thesis grade withheld until colloquium completed. Oral History includes preparation/conduct/interpretation and digital archiving. History by Numbers addresses historical quantitative sources and visualisation. Digital Historian addresses digitisation, metadata, mapping/text analysis, ethics/AI and digital history project. These defining disciplinary methods are not supplied merely by general UCR statistics.
findings.CP119Comparability: All three alternatives have sustained historical object, method and progression: six dedicated History courses / 45 EC in modern change, American gender histories with interviews, empire, warfare, Native American social/cultural history and a final primary-source research paper on Walcheren in 1809. Cultural interpretation/heritage, political conflict/institutions and political economy are materially distinct companions. Actual selected content and weights support those qualified responses; generic programme coherence alone was not accepted.

findings.courseContentAndWeight: All 40 selected enriched rows, actual profiles/descriptions/topics/methods, contribution, weight, prerequisite and assigned offerings inspected. Missing enriched outlines are not fabricated. Greek Archaeology and Heritage/Ancient Democracy share early Greek democracy content, so not counted as independent regional breadth. Contemporary economics/statistics/politics/sociology remain companion disciplines. findings.alignment: Four unsupported positive alignments withdrawn: Walcheren research to the current photography seminar; public economics to historical Capitalism/Inequality; general statistics to History by Numbers; Western philosophy to unverified Key Texts reading list. Five retained alignments are explicitly partial: modern Europe, empires/world history, historical interviewing, ancient material culture and Renaissance cultural context. External unmatched rows remain visible.
findings.limitations: VU medieval/early-modern and Netherlands breadth, Holocaust-centred genocide historiography, specialist digital history, Latin America, current devotion/photography research and compulsory individual thesis/colloquium remain gaps. Native American history, war and rights do not stand in for Holocaust/genocide training. Optional 15-EC independent research is additional to displayed UCR 180 EC and is not a replacement for the compulsory VU 9-EC thesis.
